response.description:
Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 on Azure Functions is ending on September
1, 2027. Your apps that are hosted on Azure Functions will continue to run, but
security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide
customer service for Java 8, 11 and 17. Required actionTo avoid potential security vulnerabilities, minimize risk
for your Azure Functions apps, and take advantage of latest features, follow
the steps to upgrade your Function app to Java 25 before September 1, 2027.Learn more.
response.title: Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 in Azure Functions ends on September 1, 2027
